Use the source-provided locator and native detail/reobserve Action to confirm that exact target; do not parse a display URL into authority. Preserve its source-presented reply operands and canonical publication plan. If the admitted PR/source match is unavailable or ambiguous, retain the draft and report target-unavailable. For replies, use the selected source’s admitted marked publication Actions: happier.scm.forge.github/actions/github/pull-request/thread-reply for an exact review thread; github/pull-request/review-comment-create for anchored feedback; github/pull-request/submit-review with the comment verdict for a conversation reply, quoting its original conversation URL. Prepare the canonical Reviews publication plan from the selected detail and current base/head before invoking. If the exact admitted target, plan, Action or approval is unavailable, retain the draft and ask or await approval. Do not derive targets from display URLs or fall back to shell gh, raw REST/GraphQL or an unmarked post.
